value.rationale: The Chvátal graph is the canonical smallest four-regular triangle-free four-chromatic graph, a motivated minimal high-chromatic symmetry-constrained test. Equality of both models’ eventual periods for every one of 531441 states—including periods 7, 10, 11—is not forced by generic clock-divisibility theory and contrasts with strict splits on Petersen, Frucht and Heawood graphs. The distinct orbit and entry-time counts show that matched frequency does not imply matched transient dynamics, supplying an exact reference point for understanding topology-dependent period selection.
